concept: Snow Family: offline transfer of hundreds of TB over a thin link
tests: Estimating network transfer time and choosing an offline device for a large data volume.
expected: AWS Snowball Edge — physical shipment of an encrypted device. Triggers: "500 TB", "100 Mbps", "the link is needed for daily operations" ⇒ months over the network ⇒ offline.
why_not: DataSync and S3 multipart upload go over the same thin link; Transfer Family is SFTP file exchange with partners, not a one-time migration of hundreds of TB.
